name: Streamex Gold Yield
oneLiner: GLDY is Streamex's tokenized gold ounce on Base, backed by physical bullion and gold-leasing receivables with Chainlink Proof of Reserve.
collateral: Physical gold bullion backing with issuer-managed gold leasing through Monetary Metals; Streamex presents one GLDY as one troy ounce of gold exposure with yield paid in additional gold
pegMechanism: Commodity-backed gold token with Chainlink proof-of-reserves on Base; eligible primary-market investors can redeem through the issuer process, while secondary markets price the gold-ounce claim plus accrued yield mechanics

proofOfReserves.provider: EisnerAmper LLP AICPA examination (one report to date; the Chainlink gldy-reserves feed has porSource Streamex / porType Off-chain with a 86400s heartbeat, so it transports issuer-reported ounces rather than independently attesting them)

DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE is independently held by legacy EOA 0x9625c15f7b305680c1690cd41103870e2050028d and 3-of-5 Safe 0x05ed6826524ebe9f3df837b06803ff797f4e2130. Either admin can immediately grant minters, alter reserve-oracle configuration, or upgrade mint logic; no role revocations or timelock were found.

review.evidence: At Base block 48592766, GLDY proxy 0x632db1aaace73401a5dc8cde6e9062b8ec0fd819 used UUPS implementation 0xd3a66bf0ecbf910afcc91bd2af3e724656448cb5 with zero admin and beacon slots. Role history contained six grants and no revocations. Legacy EOA 0x889133442bf36e4291c0b2e23b35b260309cb0fe and 2-of-3 Safe 0x655f31f9136d54bc319c00dd43009104646b0951 both held TREASURY_ROLE. Legacy EOA 0x9625c15f7b305680c1690cd41103870e2050028d and 3-of-5 Safe 0x05ed6826524ebe9f3df837b06803ff797f4e2130 independently held DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE and could immediately grant minters, change reserve configuration, or upgrade mint logic. The source-verified mint path retained its reserve check. EisnerAmper's first independent AICPA examination reconciled GLDY supply to allocated gold reserves at 31 March 2026, but the 1 July 2026 announcement only promises monthly reports going forward. No second report or established recurring series was available at review, and no prudential reserve supervisor was established, so reconciliation remains unknown.

reserveReview.rationale: Streamex describes GLDY as backed by investment-grade gold bullion, with some bullion leased through Monetary Metals while title remains with the issuer. The July 2026 independent examination announcement reports redemption assets measured in fine troy ounces at or above GLDY obligations; the Chainlink feed supplies the current on-chain reserve observation.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Streamex issuer disclosure, independent reserve attestation, and Chainlink Proof of Reserve
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The reviewed sources establish the physical-gold reserve category but do not disclose current bar-level custody allocation, lease-counterparty concentration, or redemption timing for each reserve position.
